annotation.title_en: Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Advanced AI system
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission (DG CONNECT), Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing the G7 Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Organizations Developing Advanced AI Systems (30 October 2023), with a download link. It describes non-exhaustive, living principles building on the OECD AI Principles to promote safe, secure and trustworthy AI, especially foundation and generative models.
key_provisions_or_claims: Principles aim to promote safe, secure, trustworthy advanced AI worldwide
Non-exhaustive living document building on OECD AI Principles
Applies to all AI actors across design, development, deployment and use
Targets foundation models and generative AI
Accompanied by a voluntary Code of Conduct for AI developers
